messages:
maya (DevEx): saw a customer hit onboarding flakiness when rotating keys. sample app rolled with 403s. quick log and repro below.
liam (SDK): ah — did they have both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY set?
maya (DevEx): yes. Env in container: 
```
REDWOOD_PROJECT=gamma-labs
REDWOOD_API_KEY=org:old
REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj:new
```
We updated project secret but image still had org key baked. Node sample kept sending org token -> 403 scope_mismatch.
harold (Eng): server logs: `auth.scope_mismatch` in structured body but frontend showed generic 403. We should surface better error text to users.
liam (SDK): investigating SDK precedence. Current implementation picks the first non-empty env var in a list (legacy behavior). That's causing org key to take effect even when REDWOOD_PROJECT is set. Plan: change precedence to: if REDWOOD_PROJECT set -> use REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY (or legacy alias) first, fallback to REDWOOD_API_KEY only if project key absent.
sophie (Docs): can we add an explicit rotation checklist to quickstart? e.g. "When rotating project keys: don't leave org keys baked into images; prefer secrets mounted at runtime; run `redwood doctor --auth` before deploy."
liam (SDK): +1. I'll add: 1) SDK change to precedence and alias support; 2) a one-time startup warning when both keys present: `console.warn('Both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY set. If REDWOOD_PROJECT is configured, project key will be used.')`; 3) a `redwood doctor --auth` lint that fails CI if both keys are detected in build context.
harold (Eng): infra side: we can improve responses. Instead of opaque 403, return JSON `{code: "auth_scope_mismatch", detail: "token not valid for project gamma-labs"}` and include header `x-redwood-expect-scope: project`. That allows SDKs and UIs to surface action links like "Rotate your project key".
liam (SDK): also changing retry semantics: do NOT retry on auth_scope_mismatch (401/403). Only retry on 429/5xx. Prevents retry storms while customers rotate keys.
infra-bot: telemetry: emitting metric `auth.scope_mismatch` with tag project=gamma-labs for funnel analysis.
ci-bot: ci: running tests for branch env-auth-precedence... unit matrix 42 passed, 1 flaky rerun queued
liam (SDK): PR up: internal/pull/3287 — flips precedence, supports legacy alias REDWOOD_PROJECTTOKEN, adds doctor lint and no-retry-on-auth. Added tests for env matrix permutations.
sophie (Docs): will add small quickstart section and a visual precedence table. Also adding an inline note: "Do not bake org API keys into images when you plan to rotate project keys."
maya (DevEx): validated sample app in staging after patch. Rotation now succeeds when swapping project key; SDK no longer falls back to org key silently. Closing this thread after doc PR lands. Thanks :rocket:
